model.name: Editor file pane shows full project filetree
model.description: The /edit Files pane shows the FULL project filetree (src / scenario / scrum.pmo / scripts / test / data / etc), expandable. THE BUG: rb-file-tree.ts:31 requests /api/files/'/' for the root -> the server's safePath('/') resolves to FS-root, fails startsWith(PROJECT_ROOT) -> {error:Forbidden} -> empty tree. PROVEN: /api/files/ (empty relPath) returns the full tree; /api/files/%2F -> Forbidden. FIX: the file-tree root request uses an EMPTY relPath (not '/') - a one-line fix at rb-file-tree.ts:31 (drop the "|| '/'" fallback).
model.tronQuote: > TRON 2026-07-13: the /edit Files pane shows an EMPTY tree. rb-file-tree.ts:31 requests /api/files/'/' -> safePath('/') = FS-root -> fails startsWith(PROJECT_ROOT) -> Forbidden. Root request must use EMPTY relPath (not '/').

discoverySource.note: Regression, S30 (reopened). Scenario-first #126. Root: rb-file-tree.ts:31 '/'-fallback -> server safePath('/') Forbidden. Fix = empty relPath. robbin-req one-mover (R29.9).
